learning_outcomes.text: Improve English knowledge to reach the level of language competence that would allow understanding and producing accurate academic and scientific texts in English, and understanding written or verbal texts on topics related to the field of engineering in general and the chosen specialization, in particular.
Produce written texts or express oneself verbally, in English.
Acquire field-related vocabulary in English and complete documents specific to the chosen field of study.

Effective use of information sources and resources of communication and assisted professional training (Internet portals, specialized software applications, databases, online courses, etc.) both in Romanian and in a language of international circulation.

syllabus_topics: Defining ICT (Information and Communication Technology). Introduction to different aspects of ICT. Vocabulary and speaking exercises.
The History of ICT. Key stages in the development of computers. Reading and vocabulary exercises.
Software development (Discussion of development methods and processes, planning the development process, open source software).
The Internet (Discussions and reading on Internet protocols and data transfer, social networking services, Web 2.0 and Web 3.0)

ICT in the Workplace (The impact of ICT on business, including communication, information, management and product design). The impact of ICT on the nature of work, including teleworking and outsourcing.
ICT in Education. Computer-assisted learning and virtual learning environments.
The impact of new ICTs on the learning of foreign languages.
Efficiency in Computer Systems (reliability, security, speed and cost)
"Inscribing Memory" – Some considerations on the evolution of forms of storing data.
ICT in the Future. Discussion about virtual and mirror worlds. Augmented reality.
E-commerce and E-government. Re-shaping communication channels and behaviour patterns, based on ICT evolution.
Final remarks and conclusions on the impact of the latest communication and information technologies upon individuals and societies worldwide.
teaching_methods: free exposition with presentation of materials on the board
assessment_rules: The evaluation can be done face-to-face or online. For passing the exam (mark 5), students are required to solve exercises meant at testing the knowledge they acquired during the semester, knowing the fundamental notions without presenting details. For a mark of 10, thorough knowledge of all subjects is required. Mandatory presence at 80% of the seminars is required. The minimum performance standard for the seminary includes the capacity to use English appropriately, produce documents in English, and use grammatical structures accurately.
